final_layer_identity.note: jlens.fit requires source_layers < target_layer (target defaults to the final layer, 35), so J35 is not a fittable object: 'source_layers must all be < target_layer=35; got max=35'. The transport at the final layer is the identity by definition, so the check reduces to: final norm + lm_head on the layer-35 residual reproduces the model's own next-token logits. Measured by fit_layer35.py's lens=None reference path on Modal (A100, 2026-09-20; means read from the run log, per-prompt rows not saved because the script aborted at the fit step). It validates the norm+unembed path only; it says nothing about the fitted J9/J18/J27 Jacobians. Preregistered check assumed a fittable J35 -- deviation to be confirmed with Gautam.
